assumptions: The lake folder is the root of the local destination, so keys are relative to it (as in the examples: 2024-03-01/SITE_0001/a.csv).

Overwriting, the _SUCCESS marker (written last, only if no file failed) and copy-not-move are covered by the fixed delivery settings (if_exists=overwrite, write_success_marker=true) and the framework's copy-based upload, so no custom_delivery step is needed (the destination is local, not S3).
The _SUCCESS marker lands in <lake>/<run date>/ because the marker is written next to the delivered files under the prefix.

steps.title: Deliver all files to <run date>/ keeping package paths

output.summary: Every package file is delivered under a folder named for the run date ({ds}, YYYY-MM-DD) in the lake folder, keeping its package path. The existing settings handle the rest: files are copied unchanged, existing files are overwritten, and the empty _SUCCESS marker is written only after all files are delivered. The source folder is not touched.
